title: Sweep LR warmdown length (WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.5 -> 0.8)
description: Changed WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.8, giving a longer/gentler linear LR cooldown starting at progress=0.2 instead of 0.5, all else unchanged from DEPTH=10 baseline.
reflection: val_bpb 1.004892, worse than the 1.002279 baseline. A longer cooldown phase (less time at peak LR) hurt in this fixed 5-minute budget, suggesting the model needs more time at full LR to reach a good loss basin before annealing, rather than a longer gentle decay. This closes off the warmdown-length axis in this direction; if anyone revisits schedule shape, shortening WARMDOWN_RATIO (e.g. 0.3) is the untested direction, not lengthening it.
